mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit margins and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the frequency of negative returns in triggered periods is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates an effective monetary policy response to a softening labor market, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising residential construction permits (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or the frequency of negative returns in triggered periods is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales (RSAFS) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) indicates strong consumer demand without price pressures, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising RSAFS and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.
